import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify feature columns
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]


# Extract raw features for engineering
def add_engineering_features(df, feature_cols):
    df = df.copy()

    # Core topographic features
    elevation = df["Elevation"].values
    aspect = df["Aspect"].values
    slope = df["Slope"].values

    # Hydrology features
    horizontal_dist_hydrology = df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"].values
    vertical_dist_hydrology = df["Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology"].values

    # Fire and road features
    horizontal_dist_fire = df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"].values
    horizontal_dist_road = df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"].values

    # Compute derived hydrology features
    horizontal_dist_hydrology_abs = np.abs(horizontal_dist_hydrology)
    vertical_dist_hydrology_abs = np.abs(vertical_dist_hydrology)
    euclidean_hydrology = np.sqrt(
        horizontal_dist_hydrology**2 + vertical_dist_hydrology**2
    )

    # Fire and road distances
    horizontal_dist_fire_abs = np.abs(horizontal_dist_fire)
    horizontal_dist_road_abs = np.abs(horizontal_dist_road)

    # Soil and wilderness type columns
    soil_type_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("Soil_Type")]
    wilderness_area_cols = [
        col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("Wilderness_Area")
    ]

    # Soil type counts per wilderness area (interaction)
    soil_type_data = df[soil_type_cols].values
    wilderness_data = df[wilderness_area_cols].values

    # Compute soil type sum per wilderness area
    soil_per_wilderness = np.dot(wilderness_data, soil_type_data.T).diagonal()

    # Add engineered features to DataFrame
    df["Elevation_log"] = np.log1p(elevation)
    df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology_abs"] = horizontal_dist_hydrology_abs
    df["Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology_abs"] = vertical_dist_hydrology_abs
    df["Euclidean_Distance_To_Hydrology"] = euclidean_hydrology
    df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_abs"] = horizontal_dist_fire_abs
    df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Road_abs"] = horizontal_dist_road_abs
    df["Soil_Wilderness_Sum"] = soil_per_wilderness

    # Compute hydrology gradients (vertical/horizontal)
    df["Hydrology_Gradient"] = vertical_dist_hydrology_abs / (
        horizontal_dist_hydrology_abs + 1
    )

    # Return dataframe with engineered features
    return df


# Add engineered features
train_eng = add_engineering_features(train, feature_cols)
test_eng = add_engineering_features(test, feature_cols)

# Identify new feature columns
feature_cols = [col for col in train_eng.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_eng[feature_cols].values
y = train_eng["Cover_Type"].values - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed for LightGBM
X_test = test_eng[feature_cols].values

# Use non-stratified split to avoid issues with rare classes
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Train model with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_pred_classes = np.argmax(val_pred, axis=1)
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred_classes)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {accuracy:.6f}")

# Train final model on full training data for submission
final_model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb.Dataset(X, label=y),
    num_boost_round=model.best_iteration,
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Generate predictions on test set (convert back to 1-indexed)
test_pred = final_model.predict(X_test)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_pred, axis=1) + 1  # 1-indexed as required

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_pred_classes})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
